primitives.name: Confirmed Injury Status
primitives.verbatim_quote: # ✅ Confirmed consistent (no action) - **Brock Bowers** — multiple hosts debated his return; `week3-injuries.md`: officially QUESTIONABLE with a Friday DNP (negative signal).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{\\text{status}}': '\\text{Binary indicator for injury status (0 = active, 1 = inactive)}', 'T_{\\text{host}}': '\\text{Transcript-derived claim value}', 'I_{\\text{file}}': '\\text{Injury file verification value}'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( T_{\text{host}} = I_{\text{file}} \), status is confirmed.

layer2.mapping: Each host claim maps to a binary verification event in GSI's probabilistic space; GSE transitions between states based on confirmation.

primitives.name: Superseded Prediction
primitives.verbatim_quote: The RotoWire BOLD prediction (8/125/1, TE1 week) was recorded pre-Friday and is **superseded**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{\\text{pred}}': '\\text{Predictive signal before update}', 'P_{\\text{new}}': '\\text{Updated prediction after Friday}', 'U': '\\text{Update flag (1 if superseded)}'}
primitives.assumptions: Predictions are time-sensitive and must be updated with new data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( U = 1 \), \( P_{\text{pred}} \) is replaced by \( P_{\text{new}} \).

layer2.mapping: GSI recalibrates prediction confidence using temporal update kernels; GSE adjusts model weights accordingly.
layer2.telemetry: Confidence interval shift in predicted performance metrics.

primitives.name: Unverified Host Claim
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Flag as host claim requiring verification against Friday final reports before use.** It strengthens the Schultz case if true (Schultz first-read rate 27% in Week 2 per RotoWire) but is not independently verified in our research lanes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_{\\text{claim}}': '\\text{Host-derived claim}', 'V': '\\text{Verification flag (0 = unverified, 1 = verified)}', 'C_{\\text{schultz}}': "\\text{Schultz's first-read rate}"}
primitives.assumptions: Claims without independent verification are unreliable until validated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( V = 0 \), \( H_{\text{claim}} \) is flagged for further scrutiny.

layer2.mapping: GSI applies uncertainty quantifiers to unverified claims; GSE delays action until validation.
layer2.telemetry: Uncertainty score assigned to claims lacking external corroboration.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators define a dual logic system: one for verifying claims against authoritative sources (confirmed injury status), another for managing outdated predictions (superseded prediction). An unverified host claim introduces a third layer where uncertainty must be quantified before integration into models. These primitives form a triadic structure underpinning GSI’s Bayesian updating and GSE’s dynamic state transitions. Failure modes include misalignment between transcript and injury data, stale predictions not updated post-Friday, and overreliance on unverified claims. Each operator defines a boundary condition in which its associated regime holds—e.g., when a claim is confirmed, it becomes part of the stable knowledge base; when superseded, it is discarded. The system avoids false positives by enforcing verification gates and prevents model drift by applying retroactive corrections.
